answer: Sybil resistance follows from an exponential temporal half-life: reputation decays unless an identity delivers sustained honest service. EigenTrust matrix factorization assigns centrality from weighted peer endorsements, while reciprocity-weighted transitivity limits influence from colluding groups. A freshly spawned sybil therefore has near-zero eigenvector centrality; whether labeled delta, lotus, or haven, it lacks trusted paths and cannot pass consensus before accumulating durable, corroborated interactions.
